scope: AI-007 LightFact-only relationship projection, immutable relationship snapshots, one-time node receipts, deletion/replay behavior, and reviewed day 1/3/7 continuity copy

assertions: zero, first, third and seventh encounter-day vectors derive the exact count, stage, canonical eligibility and publishable node without using natural-day continuity
an exact replay is deduplicated, calendar gaps do not reset the relationship, and removing a source changes the fingerprint and deterministically lowers the projection
opened, check-in, notification, Safety and vulnerability fields are rejected rather than becoming relationship evidence
the controlled registry renders only the reviewed first, third and seventh encounter-day copy and keeps the fourth-day matter invitation outside AI-007
controlled copy avoids internal source, count, Prompt, Safety and fingerprint details
exclusivity, forever promises, fabricated waiting, interruption blame, make-up pressure, relationship injury and vulnerability language are rejected
the first, third and seventh encounter-day directives limit claims to real relationship facts and require explicit prohibited-inference language
the fourth-day matter directive remains outside AI-007 and unbounded directives are rejected
changing relationship stage and count does not change RuleFacts and the current Daily v1 expression plan remains relationship_mode GENERIC with empty resolved context slots
relationship continuity is delivered as a separate deterministic DLY-003 module rather than silently widening the accepted Daily Prompt v1 memory contract

T-AI007-DB-001.selector: C-008 real PostgreSQL idempotent generation, publication and guard fences
assertions: real PostgreSQL 18 freezes the prior LightFact-derived relationship stage and count into each new generation snapshot while an existing Published result and fingerprint remain byte-stable
gapped first, third and seventh encounter days publish exactly one reviewed node receipt each; repeat Today reads and late or duplicate DayLit events do not publish another node
source removal advances the cycle revision and fingerprint, lowers the public stage, and a later threshold recross does not replay a node already published in that cycle
relationship-data deletion rejects old DayLit replay and a fresh post-cutoff cycle can publish its own first-meeting node without restoring old sources
the online authoritative Today response may carry one relationship node, but the local Today cache removes node_display so offline and subsequent cached reads cannot replay it

T-AI007-QUEUE-001.selector: C-008 outbox/inbox publishes once and Redis cache loss rebuilds from PostgreSQL
assertions: real Redis 8 loss rebuilds the same authoritative content, interaction and relationship projection from PostgreSQL without replaying the already published first-meeting node
the PostgreSQL node receipt remains unique while cache keys are rebuilt
